note: Train-local coordinates as in train.glb (three.js: nose = -Z, +Y up, x across). Heights are above the FLOOR, y_floor=0.695 above rail head.
aisleNote: benches occupy |x| in [0.62, 1.085] along benchZRanges; between benches (door vestibules, gangways) the walkable half-width is 0.62 m with poles at |x|=0.58 near doors, 1.085 m clear in door vestibules only below y=floor+1.4
headroomFormula: h(x) = 1.487 + sqrt(1.085^2 - x^2) - 0.695 for |x|<=1.085  (ceiling y minus floor)
minStandingNote: an adult of 1.75 m can only stand where headroomVsX >= 1.80 i.e. |x| <= 0.35; head-bump zone otherwise

cab.driverSide: left of centre door (x=-0.42 front cab, +0.42 rear cab)
cab.glazing: three bays (driver / centre evacuation door / right), glass y from 1.30 to 2.18, black frame, amber LED destination display node cab_dest

doors.a: nose-side leaf: open = translate -Z by 0.6 m (toward the nose)
doors.b: rear-side leaf: open = translate +Z by 0.6 m (toward the rear)
doors.leafNodeOrigin: leaf centre: x=+-1.12, y=0, z=door centre +-0.3225 (a: -0.3225 in three z, b: +0.3225)
